# GSAP vendored assets

- Version: **3.15.1** (GSAP Core and Flip).
- Official source: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP
- Immutable source revision: `5e6c35ff8eedea12d4f229129def635277d8b0f2`.
- Files copied without modification from `dist/gsap.min.js` and `dist/Flip.min.js`.
- The original copyright and license notices remain in each file: https://gsap.com/standard-license.
- No CDN request, package installation, or build is needed when playing.

- https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/
- https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/Flip/static.from()/
- https://gsap.com/docs/v3/GSAP/gsap.context()/
